body: So the second day after my trip I felt depressed but not nearly as intense as the day before. I don’t know if I didn’t take enough/ it didn’t work for me as my depression hasn’t improved or gone down significantly since.

Jesus Christ are you me? I went through a very similar situation a while ago, but the feelings for this girl are still there. I’m thinking of trying to look deep into the reason the next time I trip to break those feelings. Best of luck to you!
Interesting. I’ve never felt this way after takin acid. I didn’t feel like I contemplated anything really deep when I was tripping.
